title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: route returning customers to a previous or preferred expert
summary: The routing behaviour, administrator opt-in, publishing charge and control operations are supported by Microsoft documentation. A minor clarification should distinguish the configuration article's silence about a global switch from the Responsible AI FAQ's reference to a feature toggle. All seven Learn pages flagged by the pre-check were retrieved successfully.
